info.title: Crow HR API
info.description: Versioned REST API used by the Crow HR web app and native apps. Within v1, changes are additive only; see docs/api.md.

get.summary: List out-of-office cover
get.description: Current and upcoming cover involving the caller; hr_admins and owners see everyone's with `all=true`.

post.summary: Set out-of-office cover
post.description: While active, the delegate also receives the member's approval tasks. hr_admins may set it for anyone.

get.summary: List members who can approve or cover
get.description: Active members of the organisation (name only), for delegate and approver pickers.

get.summary: List approval policies per request type
get.description: Types without a stored policy show the built-in default chain.

put.summary: Replace the approval policies of one request type
put.description: Exactly one policy must have no condition (the default). Requests already submitted keep their chain. Payroll policies are owner-only.

get.summary: List my requests
get.description: Requests the caller submitted, newest first.

get.summary: Get a request with its approval chain
get.description: Visible to the requester, approvers, delegates while their task is open, owners and hr_admins (not payroll runs), and whoever the module's `canRead` allows.

post.summary: Comment on a request
Withdraw my pending request

get.summary: List my open approval tasks
get.description: Pending tasks assigned to the caller, including delegated, escalated and reassigned ones.

post.summary: Approve or reject several tasks
post.description: Each task is decided in its own transaction; the result lists the outcome per task.

post.summary: Approve or reject a task
post.description: Idempotent: repeating the same decision returns `replayed: true`. A task that someone else already decided answers 409 `already_decided` with who decided and when.

post.summary: Reassign a pending task

get.summary: Search the audit log
get.description: hr_admins do not see security-settings, SSO or payroll events; payroll_admins see payroll, compensation and bank events only.

targetLabel.description: Human name of the target (member, employee, department…) when it still exists.

post.summary: Sign in as a demo persona (demo mode only)
Accept an invitation with a password
post.description: Sets the password (or confirms the existing one for people already on Crow HR), activates the membership and signs in.

post.summary: Look up an invitation link

get.summary: Sign-in methods an organisation has enabled
get.description: Public. Without `org`, resolves the only organisation of a single-organisation install.

post.summary: Complete a password sign-in with a TOTP or recovery code

get.summary: Identity provider callback
get.description: The only cookie-authenticated GET with side effects; protected by `state`. Validates the ID token (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce) and the provider restrictions, links or matches the identity, then signs in.

302.description: Redirect into the app, or back to the sign-in page with an error.

get.summary: Relying-party public keys for a provider (Singpass)
Start single sign-on with a provider
get.description: Redirects to the identity provider (authorization code + PKCE S256, state and nonce kept server-side for 10 minutes). `purpose=test` is an owner's test sign-in; `purpose=link` links the provider to the signed-in user.

post.summary: Set a new password from a reset link
post.description: Single use. Revokes every session and device of the user.

post.summary: Check a password reset link before showing the form
Request a password reset email
post.description: Always answers 202, whether or not the email belongs to a member.

post.summary: Confirm it's you before a sensitive action
post.description: Password sessions: password, plus a TOTP or recovery code when MFA is enrolled. SSO sessions re-authenticate by an SSO round-trip instead.

401.description: Error: invalid_credentials, invalid_mfa_code, session_expired, session_revoked, unauthenticated.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Every failure (unknown email, wrong password, suspended, locked) answers the same 401 invalid_credentials. When MFA is enrolled the response carries a pending-sign-in token instead of a session.

post.summary: Sign out of this browser session
Switch the session to another organisation you belong to
post.description: Issues a new session token (rotation) scoped to the target organisation.

get.summary: List claims (own, team or all by role; `mine=true` for your own)

post.summary: Create a draft claim, or create and submit it (`submit: true`)

previewable.description: Images browsers can show (not HEIC or PDF).

submit.description: Submit at once; when submission fails the draft is kept (details.draftId).

get.summary: Claim types the employee may use, with cap usage for the period containing `date`

post.summary: Mark approved claims paid outside payroll (bulk, with a date and reference)

get.summary: My claim totals: waiting, approved and not yet paid, paid this year
Approved claims a payroll run for the period would reimburse (one entry per claim and type)
get.description: The same list payroll reads through `ReimbursementSource.listPayable`: approved, unpaid, payroll-payout claims approved (Asia/Singapore date) on or before `periodEnd`.

post.summary: Upload a receipt (raw bytes in the body; PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, at most 10 MB)
post.description: Send the file as the raw request body (any Content-Type; the type is detected from the file's signature, never from the name or header). `fileName` is for display only. Owners and hr_admins may upload for another employee with `employeeId`.

previewable.description: Images browsers can show (not HEIC or PDF).

get.summary: Download or view a receipt
get.description: Images are served inline, PDFs and HEIC as attachments, always with the detected type, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and a sandbox CSP. 404 for anyone who may not see it.

delete.summary: Delete an uploaded receipt that no claim line uses

Generic ISO 20022 pain.001.001.03 salary credit-transfer file (not a bank-specific format)
get.description: Open-standard file for banks that accept ISO 20022 pain.001 uploads. Each bank's message guide (service level, charge bearer, BIC length) is not applied; test the file with your bank before first use. Excluded employees are listed in the x-crowhr-excluded header (URL-encoded JSON).

get.summary: CPF EZPay (FTP) submission file for the amounts this run charged
get.description: Fixed-width file per CPF Board's CPF EZPay (FTP) File Specifications (16 Jan 2025), for upload in CPF EZPay. Employees left out (e.g. SHG for foreigners without a CPF account) are listed in the x-crowhr-excluded header (URL-encoded JSON).

IR8A figures for an income year (whole dollars, masked IDs)
get.description: Preview of the IR8A records Crow HR can fill from approved payslips, in the parts (≤ 200 records) the file download produces. Appendix 8A is not produced (no benefits-in-kind are recorded). Direct submission through IRAS's AIS-API is not available.

grossSalary.description: Whole dollars, cents dropped (IRAS income rounding)

employeeCpf.description: Whole dollars, rounded up (IRAS deduction rounding)

get.summary: IR8A rows for IRAS's IR8A import template (CSV, one part of ≤ 200 records)
get.description: Columns A–AR of the IR8A sheet of IRAS's IR8A Import Template (https://go.gov.sg/ir8a-import-template, version 1.0) with its header row: paste the data rows at row 6 of the template and import it in myTax Portal → Employment Income Records. Income is in whole dollars with cents dropped, deductions rounded up. Contains full NRIC/FIN numbers. Excluded employees are listed in the x-crowhr-excluded header (URL-encoded JSON).

get.summary: First-run setup state

post.summary: Complete first-run setup

post.summary: Check the one-time setup code
post.description: Send the code from the server logs in the `x-setup-code` header. Five wrong codes from one IP block it for 15 minutes.

get.summary: System status for owners
